title: Airbnb · Unlock Adventure
summary: Familiar rooms open onto extraordinary destinations in a cinematic travel campaign.
clientDescription: A global platform for places to stay and experiences, presented here through a campaign developed with a Kuwait-based creative studio.
challenge: Turn the promise of travel into an immediate visual surprise without losing the comfort of a familiar room.
role: Visual development, key visual design, photomontage and lighting direction.
deliverables: Campaign key visuals adapted for outdoor and digital placements.
credits: Visual development and key visuals by Ali Komeili in collaboration with a Kuwait-based creative studio. Portfolio scenes recreated from original project references; outdoor settings are presentation mockups.

blocks.title: A room can take you further.
blocks.text: The idea behind “Unlock Adventure” was to let extraordinary destinations enter the most familiar interior. Wildlife, weather and landscape change around a comfortable room, turning the ordinary threshold into the start of a journey.

blocks.title: One invitation. Many worlds.
blocks.text: Each scene pairs a credible interior with an impossible arrival. Consistent headline placement and the Airbnb mark hold the series together while the light, palette and destination shift from one execution to the next.

blocks.title: The adventure leaves the room.
blocks.text: The same visual system was considered for street-level and digital display formats. These recreated placement studies show how the images hold their message at a distance and within a busy city setting.
